standard.independence_rule: Occurrence-level severity is independent of taxonomy classification, source evidence status, workflow priority, legacy FM severity, publisher, notoriety, CAM importance, and hypothetical worst-case harm.
standard.method: Assign the maximum S1-S4 band supported by preserved evidence of materialised occurrence consequence; use SU when evidence cannot establish a consequence or distinguish adjacent bands.

sources.name: OECD, Towards a common reporting framework for AI incidents
sources.adaptation: Use harm type, severity, scope, scale and quantifiability as distinct considerations.

sources.name: CSET, Adding Structure to AI Harm
sources.adaptation: Separate actual from potential harm and consider physical, financial, property, content, treatment, privacy, rights and democratic harms.

sources.name: AI Incident Database CSETv0 taxonomy
sources.adaptation: Adapt qualitative negligible-to-critical practice to VIGIL S4-to-S1 occurrence bands without importing potential-harm ratings.
